# PAG 34


##### January 8-12, 2027


San Diego, CA


Conference


PAG 34 will be a 5-day conference (Friday through Tuesday), featuring 6 plenary talks presented by renown authorities in plant and animal genomics, 200+ scientific workshop sessions, a gallery of 1,200 poster abstracts, and an expo of 100+ companies and organizations in genomics industries.


[Event Website](https://www.intlpag.org/PAG/)
